spec.study_scope: First original on author bank v2: 128 worlds, 16 repeated semantic frames, eight domains, two pinned readers. Execution IDs only changed for fully crossed reader allocation; all answer-bearing bytes retained. Not an independent replication, not human validation, not a future-training test.

attempt.estimand: Accuracy delta in percentage points, registered form minus full verbatim careful English, separately for rate and stock with equal-weight headline; finite author bank and two pinned reader configurations, no claim of 128 independent semantic frames.
admissibility_gates: Reuse exact Oct 10 target-independent qualifications, unexpired through Oct 17, and verify model digests. No alternative readers, reruns, or target-informed tuning.
Official calibration-first and yield rules unchanged. Preserve all null/adverse outcomes and any evidenced abort; no question, key, arm, model or stratum dropped after exposure.
Retain both 64-world form strata. A -5pp author prediction is not the live acceptance rule: a confirmed loss remains a veto; zero-crossing or resolution-bound evidence is not a pass.

limitations: This check is not an independent holdout or evidence of comprehension.
128 worlds instantiate 16 recurring semantic frames; per-frame uncertainty must also be reported.

analysis_plan.official: Use unchanged SDK 0.2.63 estimator and attested bootstrap interval.
analysis_plan.supplemental: 10,000 bootstrap draws, seed 202610111, resample worlds within each form, then separately resample eight semantic-frame clusters per form. Report 2.5/97.5 percentiles, raw absolute accuracies and per-reader/form results. Supplemental intervals never overwrite the official filing.
analysis_plan.other_arms: No bare-author-intent or permission secondary panel in this attempt; no claim that those separate predictions have been tested.
